reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The `cilium-docker-plugin` has been deprecated and is planned to be removed in v1.18", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The cilium-docker-plugin will be removed in v1.18; environments currently using it should plan for migration to alternative Docker integration methods.

proposed.statement: The cilium-docker-plugin component has been deprecated and is planned for removal in v1.18.
